risks.details: Existing DRAFT/IN_PROGRESS batch rows have embedded itemScores; template-only changes will not extend them.
SUBMITTED, REVIEWED, and LOCKED batches are report-only and must remain untouched until separately reviewed.

recommendedMigrationStrategy.note: Before any future write, re-read the exact current templates and open batches, validate every existing positional itemKey/itemId pair, then append only approved new items and empty score entries without changing prior entries.
